summary: One owner for the OpenClaw 2026.9.6 to 2026.10.9 switch on the S24 (openclaw-upgrade.sh/.py), prod or preprod root: preflight (load, memory, free disk >= 3x the databases, heavy jobs, the companion-deploy lock, compat/SDK/triage prerequisites), candidate staging with the Gateway still serving (@openclaw/whatsapp 2026.10.9 installed by npm in a copy of its project), Gateway and Companion stopped by exact PID, WAL-aware SQLite backups with integrity_check, rename switch of the OpenClaw and Node trees, offline doctor --fix, gates (HTTP health, health JSON with the Samantha plugin, plugin tools, one real agent turn, WhatsApp plugin/connection, Companion readiness, no automatic triage) and a JSON receipt; any failure after the stop restores databases, config, credentials, trees and the WhatsApp project, restarts and re-judges (rolled_back).
reason: The production switch must be done today with a bounded outage and a proven way back. The rehearsal on full-size copies of the prod databases measured every phase and found two Android blockers handled here: OpenClaw 2026.10.9 plugins update refuses any temp workspace under /data (fs-safe, owner uid 1000), and Android denies /proc/net and netlink, so the Gateway is found by its owner lease and state dir instead of its port.

capabilities.reason: Operator maintenance script; no route, action, setting or capability.

architecture.reason: Reuses the companion-deploy lock, receipts directory, preflight thresholds, gateway-start.sh, companion-server.sh, gateway-preflight.py agent-leases and incident-notify.sh; no new store, scheduler, daemon or retry engine.

app_impact.detail: None until the switch is run; during the switch the app sees the Companion and Gateway down for the measured outage.

evidence: The script runs only when launched; prod is unchanged by the merge.

limitations: Not run in production. The production switch stays blocked by three external items found by the rehearsal: the 2026.10.9 secret egress proxy Worker fails at Gateway start with the prod secrets.egressProxy configuration (likely the fs-safe 0.26 /data ownership check, to be covered by the Android compatibility owner or decided as a configuration change); the automatic triage guard in gateway-start.sh (preflight refuses on triage_guard until it exists); the compatibility variants of the sibling branches (agent-exec-auth-scope, android-fs-compat, gateway-prep-stages) deployed to the checkout.
The production profile restarts the Companion (Companion gate) and waits for a live WhatsApp connection; preprod cannot exercise either (no Companion, no WhatsApp credentials).

Preprod-only adjustments: secrets.egressProxy removed from the copy to measure the rest of the path, plugin install records and npm peer links re-aimed at the preprod root, copied leases cleared. None of them is done by the production profile.
doctor dominates the outage (324 to 514 s on the full-size copies, mostly plugin peer-link checks); no faster offline mode was found.
SIGKILL of the upgrade process during the window cannot roll back; SIGTERM and SIGINT do, and the receipt names the rollback trees and backup set for a manual restore.
rollback: Revert this commit (nothing runs by itself). After a deployed switch, the receipt names openclaw.rollback-2026.9.6-<stamp>, node.rollback-<stamp> and the backup set for a manual way back.
